Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

girl noun

also girls, little girl

classical

Catull. 34.1–2
Hor. Ep. 2.1.99: puella īnfāns (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 16: Quis est haec puella quae tēcum est?

puella, puellae f.

noun, first declension

A girl of any age until she marries; in love poetry also a sweetheart.

Examples

  • jam violam puerīque legunt hilarēsque puellae

    now the boys and the laughing girls are picking violetsOv. Tr. 3.12.5

  • Diānae sumus in fidē puellae et puerī integrī

    we girls and boys, pure of heart, are in Diana’s keepingCatull. 34.1–2

Other words

  • puellula, puellulae f. — little girl

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Ter. Phorm. 1.2.31 (Lewis & Short); Catull. 61.57 (Lewis & Short)

  • virgō, virginis f. — maiden, an unmarried girl

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Rep. 2.12 (Lewis & Short)

    Usually an older girl.

See also little boy, little daughter, little sister.
